# Repair four historical E14a invocation digests before P14.3

Source: [JSON](../../decisions/D127.json). This view is for people; agents use JSON through the Task API.

## Date

2026-09-25

## Status

accepted

## Decision

Authorize exactly one `journal-migration/v1`,
`corex-e14a-invocation-digests`. Preserve the complete source journal as a
sealed preimage. On lines 308–311 replace only `batch_receipt`, changing only
`invocation_digest` from the invalid historical value to
`781caafe12b63f54d04dc64ad7679b74af1740b1d86368ed1aa5cf8cf0578f3b`,
the deterministic digest of unchanged membership `P14.1\nP14.2`. Bind every
before/after line digest and whole-file digest in the manifest and receipt.

Permit the compatible Task package bugfix that admits this single derived-field
correction only when the source receipt is invalid, the result is valid and
batch identity/membership/prefix plus routing/spec/handoff digests are unchanged.

## Rationale

An append cannot repair an invalid historical receipt. This migration preserves
all execution semantics and corrects only a value wholly derived from immutable
membership, allowing normal recovery to resume without trusting the stale value.

## D127 — Repair four historical E14a invocation digests before P14.3

**Actor:** owner / human through the exact P14.3 `task:plan-run` invocation,
with plan-maintenance / codex-gpt-5.6-sol/high.

**Evidence:** `RAG:—` P14.3 recovery failed on journal lines 308–311.
Each E14a receipt preserves membership `[P14.1, P14.2]`, batch identity,
completed prefix, routing/spec/handoff digests and terminal evidence, but carries
an invocation digest that is not SHA-256 of the newline-joined membership.
The source journal SHA-256 is
`793d09bd3385f911fb6f90376ac91814b91beeec3117864f57dd87baf4799da0`.

## Решение

Authorize exactly one `journal-migration/v1`,

before/after line digest and whole-file digest in the manifest and receipt.

Permit the compatible Task package bugfix that admits this single derived-field
correction only when the source receipt is invalid, the result is valid and
batch identity/membership/prefix plus routing/spec/handoff digests are unchanged.
